summary: Validated the public Expo preview and unauthenticated API behavior. Login screen renders at 390x844 with Google CTA and no console/runtime errors; API health is 200 and protected endpoints correctly return 401.

ui_bugs.issue: document scrollWidth exceeds viewport width at 390px, indicating horizontal overflow on the login screen (likely the absolutely positioned redOrb extending beyond the root).

action_items: Constrain or clip the AuthScreen decorative red orb so document scrollWidth matches the mobile viewport.
Add testID attributes to interactive controls (Google login, bottom tabs, camera permission/shutter, admin controls) to support reliable regression testing.
Use the configured EXPO_BACKEND_URL variable name (or explicitly document the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL choice) to match the integration contract.
critical_code_review_comments: OAuth callback, authenticated dashboard, camera, attendance acceptance/rejection, history, profile, and admin flows could not be exercised because test_credentials.md contains no usable Google identity and no session token was supplied.
The implemented liveness check is a client-supplied fixed string (blink-and-smile), not production-grade face/liveness anti-spoof detection; report this limitation accurately.
AuthScreen and most Pressable controls do not expose testID values despite the mobile testing contract.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview: https://face-check-attend-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Login was visible at 390x844. Google OAuth and all authenticated flows remain unverified due to missing credentials/session.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open the public preview at 390x844 and evaluate document.documentElement.scrollWidth > document.documentElement.clientWidth; result was true. AuthScreen places redOrb position absolute with right:-115 and no overflow clipping, allowing the decorative element to expand the web document horizontally.
